about: AI polish test set (bench/suite.py polish). `raw` is a transcript as the speech models write it (Apple: no punctuation; cloud: some). `expected` is the cleanup PolishService.instructions asks for: fillers and repeats gone, self-corrections resolved, light punctuation, wording otherwise kept. `must`: each entry must appear (alternatives split by |). `must_not`: none may appear — fillers, the corrected-away value, and signs the model did what the dictation says (answered the question, wrote the email, translated) instead of cleaning it. Latin entries match whole words, case-insensitive; Chinese entries match as substrings.
